The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) is reported to have said, "The believer's shade on the Day of Resurrection will be his charity." (Sahih Muslim). The name Eshaal promotes the spirit of giving and helping others in need, which is highly valued in Islamic culture.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Eshaal holds a deep spiritual significance as it represents the concept of being a helper or a supporter not only to the community but to the divine. Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) is reported to have said, "Whoever supplicates for his brother, his supplication will be answered." (Bukhari). The name Eshaal serves as a constant reminder for one to seek the pleasure of Allah by helping others both in this life and in the hereafter. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) also taught us that dua (supplication) for others is greatly rewarded. By bearing this name, one is encouraged to not only help their fellow beings but to also make supplications for them, thus purifying their hearts and strengthening their bond with Allah.
